name: batch-progress
title: Batch progress
description: Progress for work on many items at once: one bar, a count of done, failed and waiting, and a Cancel that stops the rest.
docs: total, done and failed are counts of items; done and failed are kept apart, so the bar shows done plus failed and the rest is waiting. label names the progress bar. status is 'running', 'cancelling' or 'complete'; onCancel adds the Cancel button, and on complete it gives way to Done. The failed share is hatched at the end of the bar, never thinner than 6px, so a few failures in a big batch still show. The bar is a real progressbar with aria-valuetext; the counts line is not a live region, and a status is spoken only at each tenth of the way, when cancelling starts and when the batch is done.
